configure-server.name: configure-server
configure-server.description: Configure channels, languages, and more for your server notifications

languages.label: Notification Languages
languages.description: One or more languages in which the notifications will be posted

tone.label: Bot Tone
tone.description: The personality and tone the bot will use when speaking in this server

channel.label: Notification Channel
channel.description: The destination channel where the bot will post notifications

notification-create.name: create-notification
notification-create.description: Create a new automated server notification

name.name: name
name.description: A unique name to identify this notification

ensure-performances-available.name: ensure-performances-available
ensure-performances-available.description: Control if movies without announced theatrical showtimes are included

search-key.name: search-key
search-key.description: A fuzzy-matched keyword or title for movie searches

genre.name: genre
genre.description: Filter matches to only include movies with the selected genre

min-vote-average.name: min-vote-average
min-vote-average.description: Minimum TMDB vote average required, from 0 to 10 (decimals allowed)

recurrence-pattern.name: recurrence-pattern
recurrence-pattern.description: The time cycle determining how often the notification triggers

recurrence-interval.name: recurrence-interval
recurrence-interval.description: The multiplier value applied to the recurrence pattern

configure-server.validation-failure:
## ⚠️ Validation Error
One or more of your provided configuration options are invalid:<% it.issues.forEach(function(issue) { %> 
- <%= issue %><% }) %>
configure-server.languages: All provided languages must be one of the following valid types: <% it.languages.forEach(function(language, index) { %><% if (index !== 0) { %>, <% } %>**<%= language %>** <% }) %>
configure-server.tone: The selected bot tone must be one of the following valid types: <% it.tones.forEach(function(tone, index) { %><% if (index !== 0) { %>, <% } %>**<%= tone %>**<% }) %>
configure-server.channel: A valid target notification channel is required

notification-create.validation-failure:
## ⚠️ Validation Error
One or more of your provided notification options are invalid:<% it.issues.forEach(function(issue) { %> 
- <%= issue %><% }) %>
notification-create.name: A unique notification name between `1` and `255` characters is required
notification-create.duplicate-name: A notification with the name `<%= it.name %>` already exists in this server
notification-create.search-key: The search key must contain between `1` and `255` characters
notification-create.genre: The selected genre must be a valid genre supported by the system
notification-create.min-vote-average: The minimum vote average must be a numeric value between `0` and `10`
notification-create.recurrence-pattern: The recurrence pattern must be one of the following types: <% it.recurrencePatterns.forEach(function(pattern) { %><% if (index !== 0) { %>, <% } %>**<%= pattern %>**<% }) %>
notification-create.recurrence-interval: The recurrence interval must be a positive number greater than `0`
notification-create.filter-required: At least one active search filter must be defined: `search-key`, `genre`, or `min-vote-average`
